pages.title: Olaf Peeking Over a Snowbank While Marshmallow Guards the Ice Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: Olaf peeks over a snowbank in this printable coloring page while Marshmallow stands guard before the ice palace, framed by tall, pointed crystal towers. Olaf's twig hands rest on the snow in the foreground. Broad snowdrifts leave open areas on the coloring sheet, contrasting with the guardian's spikes and the palace's narrow geometric sections.

pages.title: Olaf Relaxing Beneath a Beach Umbrella with Sunglasses and Iced Tea Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Olaf relaxing in a deck chair beneath a beach umbrella, wearing sunglasses and holding iced tea beside the ocean. A straw and citrus slice decorate his glass, with a starfish and seashell on the sand. Wide umbrella panels and rounded snowman sections give the coloring sheet broad spaces between smaller details.

pages.title: Olaf Offering His Sausage Nose to a Hungry Wolf in the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: Olaf offers his sausage nose to a hungry wolf in this printable coloring page, holding it out on one twig hand among rolling snowdrifts. The seated wolf leans toward the sausage with its tongue hanging out, while Olaf's face has no nose. Snow-covered fir trees and the wolf's pointed fur outlines complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Olaf Playing Hide-and-seek with a Snowgie Behind a Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Olaf playing hide-and-seek with a Snowgie around a large tree, each character peeking from a different side of the trunk. Olaf presses his twig hands against the bark while the Snowgie smiles near the base. The coloring sheet pairs open snowbanks with smaller bark lines, branches, and distant fir trees.

pages.title: Olaf Discovering a Jack-o'-lantern on an Arendelle Doorstep Coloring Page
pages.description: Olaf discovers a jack-o'-lantern on an Arendelle doorstep in this printable coloring page, raising his twig hands beside the pumpkin's triangular eyes and toothy grin. A decorated wooden door, ring knocker, and flower box frame the scene. The coloring sheet has broad pumpkin sections alongside smaller door motifs, flowers, and stone paving joints.

pages.title: Frozen Olaf in Winter Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This simple printable coloring page shows Olaf smiling with both twig arms spread wide in a winter village, between two small houses with snowy roofs. Fir trees and a gently curved snowbank form the sparse background. Thick outlines and large open body sections keep the coloring sheet uncluttered, with smaller spaces around the carrot nose and windows.
